rationale.faithfulness: H72's own model (starvation) fails again, now on held-out data (eps_S -0.01). The reconciled account is identified: self-share makes 65% [59, 71] of the aging clocks' held-out information redundant against <= 22% in intrinsic-aging and frailty worlds, with the urn's coefficient (1.09) and a slope that transfers to G38 and back. Chatter hold -0.085 survives day FE and first wakes in G51 but does not replicate (CI above 0 in G03, G17). Scorecard A1 B1 C2 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Operator: judge an idle agent's stuckness by its own re-pauses in context, not by time since input; neither quiet nor chatter frees it; erase the context (H16) or name it. Small chatter effect (48 messages ~ x0.72 escape odds). The portable urn coefficient supports a cross-period stuck-agent monitor.

one_line: Trap aging is not input starvation: in #51 the context's self-share carries 65% of the aging clocks' held-out information (starvation -1%, chatter 22%), and undirected chatter adds a weak hold (beta_C -0.085) that a mention cancels.

models.note: Past directed input does not set idle escape (held-out eps_S -0.01); undirected chatter dose holds weakly (-0.085); a rates race (slope -1) fails
